chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"The trader is sinful, and the sinful one is in the Fire, except for the one who takes what is right and gives what is right."

key_terms.النَّارِ: the Fire; punishment in the Hereafter
key_terms.الْحَقَّ: what is rightfully due; the just and rightful claim
key_terms.اَلتَّاجِرُ: the trader; one engaged in buying and selling
key_terms.فَاجِرٌ: sinful; one prone to moral corruption or wicked conduct

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about honesty and sin in trade?
ai.summary: This hadith warns of the moral danger found in trade and worldly transactions. It teaches that salvation in commerce lies in justice and honesty: taking only what one rightfully deserves and giving others their due.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3729 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"The trader is sinful, and the sinful one is in the Fire-except for the one who takes what is right and gives what is right."
